model: XGBoost classifier (max_depth=5, n_estimators=200), trained with fleet-subset missing-value augmentation
note: Metrics are on the held-out FAILURE class - accuracy is omitted on purpose because the data is highly imbalanced (~3.4% failures). 'failure_class' uses all 5 sensors; 'failure_class_realistic_subset' scores each test row through the device sensor subsets the fleet actually reports (missing sensors as null).
